footprints.description: Same Sky NSIM-12-A nano SIM card socket (push-in, auto eject), 7 contacts + shield tabs

Signal pads 7-0.60 x 7-0.75 on a 1.10 pitch (6-1.10), C3 at -4.20 from the centre line (4.20), order C3 C7 C2 C6 SW C5 C1 = x -4.20..+2.40; SW(CD switch) = pin 7. Shield tabs (pin 8), y measured up from the front edge y=+6.68: 2-5.87 left at x -5.87, y = 6.68-12.56 = -5.88 and 6.68-6.43 = +0.25 (12.56, 6.43), 0.70 x 1.50 at x -5.35 (5.35), y = 6.68-1.08 = +5.60 (1.08); 3-5.89 right at y -4.15 / +0.05 / +5.35 (10.83 / 6.63 / 1.33 from the front edge), sizes 5-0.85 x 3-2.00 / 3-1.60 as printed. Row distance: bottom row is 12.05 - 0.25 = 11.80 below the top row (3-12.05 to the line, 3-0.25 offset of the bottom pads) so rows at y = -5.90 / +5.90. Side shield pads (pin 7 SHIELD) 2-1.00 x 2-3.00 at x = +-5.30 (5.30, 5.30); y = top row + (12.05-6.21) = +5.84 -> -5.90+5.84 = -0.06 (2-6.21 from the line 12.05). footprints.description: Same Sky NSIM-4-B nano SIM card socket (push in, pull out), 6 contacts + CD + GND tabs
